datasets.method: Nearest source MOLA pixel to each 0.1-degree grid-cell center; original source retained.
datasets.resolution_note: Coarse global grid for lookups and overview. Use source 463 m GeoTIFF for detailed regional route analysis.

datasets.source: Derived from mola_elevation using centered finite differences and latitude-adjusted east-west distance.
datasets.resolution_note: Coarse global slope indicator; polar rows beyond 85 degrees are masked.

datasets.source: Derived as the elevation range in a 3x3 neighborhood of the coarse MOLA grid.
datasets.resolution_note: Local relief proxy at coarse grid scale, not a geologic roughness measurement.

datasets.method: Nearest source pixel to each 0.1-degree global grid-cell center; outside 60S-60N set to source no-data value.
datasets.interpretation: SWIM ice-consistency indicator for 0-1 m depth, not water volume or a calibrated probability. Preserve signed values and no-data mask.

datasets.model: Mars Climate Database v6.2; climatology average solar scenario
datasets.method: Five map anchors x four solar longitudes; local solar noon; horizontal and high-resolution local-slope flux; 10 m above local surface.
datasets.interpretation: Model output, not daily energy yield or delivered panel power.
